'''1999 Star Wars Celebration tournament''' was the Star Wars CCG play at Star Wars Celebration I in Denver, 30 April – 2 May 1999. The Information Broker ([[Tim Guzman]]) published a report on [[The Outer Rim (fan site)|The Outer Rim]].<ref name="cel">[https://www.geocities.ws/ev9d11/TheOuterRim/Articles/Celebrationreport.htm Star Wars Celebration Report], The Outer Rim (The Information Broker). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261029234045/https://www.geocities.ws/ev9d11/TheOuterRim/Articles/Celebrationreport.htm Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Dates:''' 30 April – 2 May 1999<ref name="cel" />
* '''Site:''' Denver<ref name="cel" />
* '''Friday Swiss players:''' 93<ref name="cel" />

== Side events ==

* Saturday [[1999 Star Wars Celebration EPP Overdrive]]: [[Chris Hines]] first.<ref name="cel" />
* Young Jedi sealed world premiere, 70 players: Guzman fourth.<ref name="cel" />
* Young Jedi constructed on Sunday: Guzman and Hansen dropped after game 3.<ref name="cel" />

[[Michael Girard]] taught Guzman Young Jedi at the Decipher booth on Friday.<ref name="cel" />
